text: Implemented finite BaselineExports matrix over checked ResultTable schemas: scalar/structured pairs, source-bound reductions/contrasts, repetition edges, point sources/controls/samples/bins, fixed/learned coefficients/predictions/exclusions, OLS coefficients/diagnostics/cells, and existing study/temporal CSV adapters. Portable canonical JSON cells, exact Int64, explicit validity, structured failures, units, metadata and SHA-256 preserve interpretation. Added optional JVM-only Arrow 19.0.0 with bounded batches, null/schema/label equivalence and explicit resource finalizers. Compiled public example emits 22 artifact triples; base R and PyArrow 19.0.1 independently verify all values, schemas, metadata and recomputed hashes; both reject corrupted score. Fresh regeneration reproduces every frozen artifact digest (/tmp/eyes4s-export-regeneration2.log). Full CI gate passed 3957 tests across 24 groups plus header/format/workflow/boundaries (/tmp/eyes4s-twelve-full-gates2.log). Registry integrates new point/repetition conventional schemas with published codec laws and killed mutants. Fixed learned input hash and numeric OLS provenance portability; retained actual one-ulp learned-output differences. See docs/RESULT_EXPORTS.md, schema/receipt and evidence file.
